name: @snort/worker-relay
description: A nostr relay in a service worker
author: Kieran

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bunx --bun tsc && bun run build:esm
scripts.build:esm: bunx --bun esbuild src/worker.ts --bundle --minify --sourcemap --outdir=dist/esm --format=esm --out-extension:.js=.mjs && cp node_modules/@sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm/sqlite-wasm/jswasm/sqlite3.wasm dist/esm/sqlite3.wasm && cp node_modules/@sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm/sqlite-wasm/jswasm/sqlite3-opfs-async-proxy.js dist/esm/sqlite3-opfs-async-proxy.js
